title: Zesty Ethiopian Lamb Berbere Stew
description: A briny, chewy lamb stew infused with berbere spice and a splash of white wine, perfect for a nostalgic dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, lean
ingredients.notes: trim excess fat, cut into 2cm cubes

instructions: Trim excess fat from 500g lamb shoulder and cut into 2cm cubes.
Heat a Dutch oven over medium heat, add 1 tbsp olive oil, and brown lamb cubes until sealed on all sides.
Add 1 diced onion (200g) and 4 minced garlic cloves to the pot, sautéing until onion turns translucent.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes to release its flavor.
Pour in 150ml white wine, scraping the bottom of the pot to deglaze and let it reduce by half.
Add 2 diced carrots (200g), 1 sliced bell pepper (150g), 4 cups (1000ml) low-sodium broth, and 2 tbsp berbere spice, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer gently for 60 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After the first hour, check the consistency; if too thick, add a splash of water or broth to reach desired stew thickness.
Season with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper, adjusting to taste.
Serve hot over cooked quinoa or flatbread, optionally garnished with fresh cilantro.
